title: Nice Flaky German Apple Skewers
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring apples, light rum, and a hint of citrus, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together light rum, lemon juice, and honey until well combined.
Add the sliced apples to the bowl and toss to coat with the rum mixture.
Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a large sheet, about 1/4 inch thick.
Cut the pastry dough into long strips, about 1 inch wide.
Thread a few slices of apple onto each pastry strip, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the pastry with melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg.
Grill the apple skewers on the robata grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve the Nice Flaky German Apple Skewers warm, garnished with additional cinnamon if desired.
